tasks.title: Upgrade Java 8 → 17 in POM
changes: Update <java.version> from 8 to 17
Update <maven.compiler.source> from 8 to 17
Update <maven.compiler.target> from 8 to 17
tasks.successCriteria: mvn compile succeeds with Java 17 compiler settings

tasks.title: Update Dockerfile base images to Java 17
changes: Build stage: maven:3.8-openjdk-8 → maven:3-eclipse-temurin-17
Runtime stage: eclipse-temurin:8-jre → eclipse-temurin:17-jre
Verify JAR filename matches in COPY instruction
tasks.successCriteria: docker build succeeds with Java 17 base images

tasks.title: Upgrade Spring Boot 2.7.18 → 3.2+
changes: Update spring-boot-starter-parent version from 2.7.18 to 3.2.x (latest stable)
Spring Framework automatically upgrades from 5.3.x to 6.x
tasks.successCriteria: POM dependency resolution succeeds with Spring Boot 3.2+

tasks.title: Migrate javax.persistence → jakarta.persistence
changes: Replace 'import javax.persistence.*' with 'import jakarta.persistence.*' in Vendor.java
Replace 'import javax.persistence.*' with 'import jakarta.persistence.*' in PurchaseOrder.java
Replace 'import javax.persistence.*' with 'import jakarta.persistence.*' in Inventory.java
tasks.successCriteria: All 3 entity classes compile with jakarta.persistence imports

tasks.title: Rename MySQL connector dependency
changes: Change groupId from 'mysql' to 'com.mysql'
Change artifactId from 'mysql-connector-java' to 'mysql-connector-j'
Remove explicit version 8.0.33 (use Spring Boot BOM managed version)
tasks.successCriteria: MySQL connector resolves from Maven Central with new coordinates

tasks.title: Update deprecated Hibernate dialect
changes: Replace 'org.hibernate.dialect.MySQL5InnoDBDialect' with 'org.hibernate.dialect.MySQLDialect'
Hibernate 6 auto-detects MySQL storage engine (InnoDB)
tasks.successCriteria: Application starts and JPA operations work with MySQLDialect

tasks.title: Full build verification after Spring Boot upgrade
changes: Run mvn clean compile — verify no compilation errors
Run mvn test — verify all tests pass
Run mvn package -DskipTests — verify JAR builds
Verify application can start (smoke test)
tasks.successCriteria: mvn clean package succeeds with zero errors on Spring Boot 3.2+ / Java 17

tasks.title: Fix HTTP → HTTPS URLs and externalize config
changes: Remove hardcoded 'http://localhost:8080/api' from SupplyChainBackendApplication.java
Move 'http://vendor-rating-service/api/ratings/' from VendorService.java to application.yml
Add configurable vendor-rating-service base URL in application.yml
Replace all http:// with https:// in service URLs
Inject URL from @Value annotation in VendorService
tasks.successCriteria: No hardcoded HTTP URLs in source code; all external URLs are HTTPS and configurable

tasks.title: Convert @Autowired field injection → constructor injection
changes: Remove @Autowired annotations from all injected fields
Make injected fields 'private final'
Add @RequiredArgsConstructor (Lombok) to each class
Keep @Value-annotated fields non-final (not included in constructor)
tasks.successCriteria: All 6 classes use constructor injection; build compiles; tests pass

tasks.title: Replace System.out.println with SLF4J logging
changes: Add @Slf4j annotation to SupplyChainBackendApplication
Replace System.out.println calls with log.info() using structured messages
tasks.successCriteria: No System.out.println calls in codebase; startup messages use SLF4J

tasks.title: Migrate RestTemplate → RestClient
changes: Replace RestTemplate bean with RestClient bean in AppConfig.java
Update VendorService to use RestClient.get().uri(...).retrieve().body() pattern
Remove RestTemplate import from VendorService.java
tasks.successCriteria: VendorService works with RestClient; no RestTemplate references remain

tasks.title: Migrate RabbitMQ → Azure Service Bus
changes: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with Azure Service Bus Spring Cloud starter in pom.xml
Remove RabbitMQ connection config from application.yml
Add Azure Service Bus connection config to application.yml
Remove RabbitMQ beans (Queue, RabbitTemplate, MessageConverter) from AppConfig.java
Add Azure Service Bus sender/processor beans to AppConfig.java
Replace rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend() calls in PurchaseOrderService.java
Replace rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend() calls in InventoryService.java
Migrate 3 queues: order.created, inventory.alert, approval.pending
tasks.successCriteria: All 3 message queues functional on Azure Service Bus; no RabbitMQ references in code; build passes

tasks.title: Externalize credentials to Azure Key Vault & configure Azure MySQL

target.target_technology: Azure Key Vault with Managed Identity

changes: Add azure-spring-cloud-starter-keyvault-secrets dependency to pom.xml
Add azure-identity dependency for Managed Identity support
Remove cleartext passwords from application.yml
Add Azure Key Vault endpoint configuration
Update MySQL datasource URL for Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server
Enable SSL for MySQL connection (useSSL=true, requireSSL=true)
Configure passwordless auth with Managed Identity (optional)
tasks.successCriteria: No cleartext passwords in application.yml; secrets resolved from Azure Key Vault at runtime
